correctness.rationale: H(s,t)=ζ^{h(st)} with h(u)=au+bu². Subtraction of zero row/column reduces determinant to (ζ^{h(st)}−1) on Fp×. Multiplicative-character Fourier basis maps χ(t) to χ^{-1}(s) with factor Lχ; inversion contributes (−1)^((p−3)/2). For a≠0 the phase has a nonzero singleton nonzero fiber: linear bijection if b=0, or quadratic critical value h(−a/(2b))=−a²/(4b) if b≠0. For nontrivial χ, cyclotomic disjointness Q(ζ_p)∩Q(ζ_{p−1})=Q implies vanishing would give all phase-fiber weighted counts equal; zero character sum then makes all zero, contradicting singleton χ(u0). Trivial-character factor has negative real part. For a=0,b≠0, rows/columns indexed by square values reduce to a (p+1)/2 square prime-Fourier minor, nonzero by Chebotarev. a=b=0 all ones. Independent numerical SVD checked all 373 coefficient pairs for primes 3,5,7,11,13.
